title: On the geometry of Certain Non-Basic Affine Deligne-Lusztig Varieties
summary: Let $F$ be a non-Archimedean local field, let $L=\breve F$, and let $G=\mathrm{GL}_n$. Let $M\subset G$ be a standard Levi subgroup and let $b\in M(L)$ be basic in $M$, but not necessarily basic in $G$. For a dominant cocharacter $μ$, we study the reduction-to-Levi morphism $β:X^G_μ(b)\to \bigsqcup_{μ_M\in S_M(μ,ν_b)}X^M_{μ_M}(b)$ for affine Deligne--Lusztig varieties in the affine Grassmannian.
